import { WebGLRenderer } from 'three';

/** Everything page mode forbids, one per line. */
export function badPage(renderer: WebGLRenderer, host: HTMLElement): void {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {});
  setTimeout(() => {}, 16);
  setInterval(() => {}, 16);
  renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {});
  host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
  const started = Date.now();
  const created = new Date();
  const precise = performance.now();
  const noise = Math.random();
  host.style.cssText = 'transition: opacity 1s';
  host.innerHTML = `<iframe src="x"></iframe>${started}${created.getTime()}${precise}${noise}`;
  host.innerHTML += '<video autoplay></video>';
  host.innerHTML += '<animate attributeName="x" />';
  host.style.cssText = 'animation-timeline: scroll()';
  const stamped = new Date(0);
  console.log(stamped.getTime(), globalThis.performance.now());
  host.style.cssText = 'animation: spin 1s linear infinite';
  host.style.cssText = 'animation-name: spin';
  host.innerHTML += '<style>@keyframes spin { to { opacity: 0; } }</style>';
  const id = crypto.randomUUID();
  const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(4));
  requestIdleCallback(() => {});
  queueMicrotask(() => {});
  setImmediate(() => {});
  console.log(id, bytes.length);
}
